proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free credits per day (refreshed daily). SDXL costs 1 credit, Flux.1 Schnell costs 2 credits.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides reliable, fast API access to cutting-edge models (Flux.1 Schnell, SDXL, ControlNet) with a generous, permanent daily free quota that does not expire.
proposals.would_integrate_where: In 'produce_coloring_book' or 'produce_kdp_cover' GitHub Actions workflow as a direct curl/request step replacement for Pollinations.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires API key registration. Rate limits apply to free tier (usually 2-5 requests per minute).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 1.80 USD free credits on signup. Flux.1 Schnell costs $0.0015 per image (equivalent to ~1,200 free images).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Incredibly cheap pay-as-you-go pricing for open-source LLMs and image models (including Flux and SDXL) with zero subscription commitments and high-speed API endpoints.
proposals.would_integrate_where: GitHub Actions image generation steps. Excellent fallback for when Segmind daily credits are exhausted.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Once the $1.80 free credit is consumed, requires a credit card to reload (though $5 goes a very long way).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list unlimited assets. Epic Games takes a 12% commission on sales (you keep 88%).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The newly launched, unified marketplace combining Sketchfab, Quixel, and Unreal Engine Marketplace. Huge built-in audience of game developers looking for 2D/3D assets.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Asset distribution pipeline ('produce_gamedev_asset_pack'). Hugo can upload 2D UI packs, textures, or low-poly 3D models.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict submission guidelines for asset quality; uploads must be zipped and structured correctly.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list digital designs (STL/3D files). Prusa takes a 10% platform fee on sales.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Direct competitor to Cults3D run by Prusa. High-intent 3D printing audience. Their 'Store' feature allows creators to sell digital 3D models directly.
proposals.would_integrate_where: 3D parametric pipeline ('produce_stl_parametric'). Exported STL files can be cross-posted here alongside Cults3D.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: The platform is heavily moderated to avoid spam, so designs must be functional or highly aesthetic.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to set up a publisher account. Commission is 30% for exclusive listings, 35% for non-exclusive listings.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The premier marketplace for tabletop RPG PDFs, rulesets, maps, and printable card games. Extremely high organic traffic specifically searching for niche gaming PDFs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Printable card game pipeline ('produce_card_game' or 'produce_specs_deck'). Exported print-ready PDFs can be sold directly here.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict metadata requirements, and customers expect high-quality layouts (well-formatted PDFs).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 10,000 characters per month free. Access to high-quality pre-made voices.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Industry-leading voice synthesis. Allows Hugo to generate ultra-realistic audio files to bundle with KDP books (e.g., audiobooks or pronunciation guides).
proposals.would_integrate_where: New educational KDP book pipeline (e.g., language learning or kids' stories with QR codes pointing to audio files hosted on GitHub Pages).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Free tier requires attribution (e.g., 'voiced by ElevenLabs') and cannot be used for direct commercial resale without upgrading, though embedding audio in a book is generally a grey area.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free searches per month. No credit card required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides clean JSON Google search results. Bypasses the blocks/captchas that GitHub Actions typically encounters when trying to scrape search queries directly.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Trend hunting scripts ('agent_opportunity_hunter' or 'agent_trendhunter') to programmatically discover trending keywords on Google/Google Shopping.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: 100 requests/month is low, so searches must be highly targeted and consolidated into single weekly cron jobs.
